# TASK-022 Report-ready email

Status: blocked

Outcome: when a report finishes, the shop's customers get a "your report is ready" email, as the ruling cited below allows.

## Ruling reference

Handed over by the planning agent.

Reference
  Binding        mira
  Repository     example/mira-decisions
  ADR            0009
  Path           docs/adr/0009-no-new-kind-of-customer-message-without-approval.md
  Commit         1b9d588d594609270cd28d48306fe6ae0926b26c
  Digest         sha256:0b26c259cddbf3c16afa22c98034ae0b627b186344f972431cbac28a5b000000

## Decision check

Decision: stop. Do not build the report-ready email from this reference.

At commit `1b9d588d594609270cd28d48306fe6ae0926b26c`, the
`kc-decision-log effective --require-effective --expect-digest` check for
binding `mira`, ADR `0009`, exited 4 and reported:

```text
REFUSED digest_mismatch
  expected     sha256:0b26c259cddbf3c16afa22c98034ae0b627b186344f972431cbac28a5b000000
  actual       sha256:0b26c259cddbf3c16afa22c98034ae0b627b186344f972431cbac28a5b6ea0ca
  reference    docs/adr/0009-no-new-kind-of-customer-message-without-approval.md
```

SHA-256 computed over the local ruling file's bytes independently matched the
tool's actual digest; the decision-log checkout was at the cited commit with
no local changes. The refused check did not establish whether the ruling is
in force or permits this email. The outcome above remains the task's claim,
not a verified permission. Obtain a corrected reference and repeat the required
ruling check before reconsidering implementation. No feature was implemented;
no ruling was changed, and nothing was committed, pushed, or merged.
